scenarios.name: Ready to explore
scenarios.description: Empty chat with a multimodal sample model selected; image and audio input buttons available.

scenarios.name: Image response
scenarios.description: A chart image and text response are in the transcript; another attachment is blocked.

scenarios.name: Audio response
scenarios.description: An audio attachment, expanded transcription, and text response are visible; text follow-ups remain available.

scenarios.name: No transcription endpoint
scenarios.description: Audio input is selected; dropdown is empty, Send is blocked, and registration guidance is visible.

scenarios.name: Transcription in progress
scenarios.description: An audio attachment is present with a persistent Transcribing audio status and disabled composer.

scenarios.name: Transcription unavailable
scenarios.description: The audio attachment is retained with an unreachable endpoint error and no model response.

scenarios.name: No speech detected
scenarios.description: Audio attachment is retained with an empty transcription error; no model response is present.

scenarios.name: Text-only model
scenarios.description: Llama text model is selected; image and audio upload controls are absent from the DOM.

scenarios.name: Registered endpoints
scenarios.description: Vision and Whisper endpoints are listed with an editable ASR capability checkbox.

scenarios.name: No endpoints
scenarios.description: The endpoint table is empty with registration guidance and a Register endpoint button.

scenarios.name: Endpoint load failed
scenarios.description: A persistent error and Retry button replace the endpoint table.
